steps.title: Share Your Idea
steps.description: Tell us what you want to create - from educational content to engaging stories. Our AI understands your vision and prepares to bring it to life.

steps.title: AI Magic Happens
steps.description: Our AI generates professional visuals, voice, and music for your content. Watch as your idea transforms into a polished video in minutes.

steps.title: Review & Customize
steps.description: Preview and fine-tune each scene until it's perfect for your audience. Adjust visuals, voice, and music to match your vision exactly.

steps.title: Share & Grow
steps.description: Publish your content across platforms and watch your audience grow. Download your videos in multiple formats or share directly to social media.
